challenge.results: The SPDX name uses “Non Commercial,” its text heading uses “Attribution-NonCommercial 1.0,” and the publisher adds “Generic.” SPDX flattens the publisher's nested §5 list into a paragraph. The identifier and both URL fields nevertheless select the exact BY-NC 1.0 capture.

limitations: The finding covers the literal SPDX identifier and citation. Differences in typography and section formatting leave semantic equivalence untested. Finality, legal effect, downstream grants, translations, project-wide scope and redistribution rights remain unresolved.
